items.source: Create a new ConcurrentReferenceHashMap instance.
items.translation: 创建一个新的ConcurrentReferenceHashMap 实例。

items.source: initialCapacity - the initial capacity of the map
items.translation: initialCapacity - 映射的初始容量

items.source: concurrencyLevel - the expected number of threads that will concurrently write to the map
items.translation: concurrencyLevel - 预期将并发写入该 Map 的线程数

items.source: Return a ConcurrentReferenceHashMap.Reference to the ConcurrentReferenceHashMap.Entry for the specified key, or null if not found.
items.translation: 返回指定 `key` 的ConcurrentReferenceHashMap.Reference到ConcurrentReferenceHashMap.Entry，如果未找到则返回 `null`。

items.source: referenceType - the reference type used for entries (soft or weak)
items.translation: referenceType - 用于条目（软引用或弱引用）的引用类型

items.source: loadFactor - the load factor. When the average number of references per table exceeds this value, resize will be attempted.
items.translation: loadFactor - 负载因子。当表中每个元素的平均引用数超过此值时，将尝试进行扩容。

items.source: This class can be used as an alternative to Collections.synchronizedMap(new WeakHashMap<K, Reference<V>>()) in order to support better performance when accessed concurrently. This implementation follows the same design constraints as ConcurrentHashMap with the exception that null values and null keys are supported.
items.translation: 该类可作为替代方案，用于 `Collections.synchronizedMap(new WeakHashMap>())`，以在并发访问时提供更好的性能支持。此实现遵循与ConcurrentHashMap相同的设计约束，但支持`null`值和`null`键。

items.source: NOTE: The use of references means that there is no guarantee that items placed into the map will be subsequently available. The garbage collector may discard references at any time, so it may appear that an unknown thread is silently removing entries.
items.translation: 注意： 使用引用意味着无法保证放入 Map 中的项随后仍可访问。垃圾收集器随时可能丢弃引用，因此看起来像是某个未知线程在静默地移除条目。

items.source: If not explicitly specified, this implementation will use soft entry references.
items.translation: 如果未明确指定，此实现将使用软引用。

items.source: Factory method that returns the ConcurrentReferenceHashMap<K,V>.ReferenceManager. This method will be called once for each ConcurrentReferenceHashMap<K,V>.Segment.
items.translation: 返回 ConcurrentReferenceHashMap<K,V>.ReferenceManager 的工厂方法。 此方法将为每个 ConcurrentReferenceHashMap<K,V>.Segment 调用一次。

items.source: Factory method that returns the ConcurrentReferenceHashMap<K,V>.ReferenceManager.
items.translation: 返回 ConcurrentReferenceHashMap<K,V>.ReferenceManager 的工厂方法。

items.source: A reference to an ConcurrentReferenceHashMap.Entry contained in the map.
items.translation: 对包含在映射中的ConcurrentReferenceHashMap.Entry的引用。

items.source: Strategy class used to manage References.
items.translation: 用于管理References的 Strategy 类。

items.source: Get the hash for a given object, apply an additional hash function to reduce collisions. This implementation uses the same Wang/Jenkins algorithm as ConcurrentHashMap. Subclasses can override to provide alternative hashing.
items.translation: 获取给定对象的哈希值，并应用额外的哈希函数以减少冲突。此实现使用了与ConcurrentHashMap相同的 Wang/Jenkins 算法。子类可以重写以提供替代的哈希方法。

items.source:
Calculate a shift value that can be used to create a power-of-two value between
the specified maximum and minimum values.
items.translation: 计算一个偏移值，该值可用于在指定的最大值和最小值之间创建一个 2 的幂次方值。

items.source:
Remove any entries that have been garbage collected and are no longer referenced.
Under normal circumstances garbage collected entries are automatically purged as
items are added or removed from the Map. This method can be used to force a purge,
and is useful when the Map is read frequently but updated less often.
items.translation: 移除任何已被垃圾回收且不再被引用的条目。在正常情况下，垃圾回收的条目会随着向 Map 添加或删除项目而自动清除。此方法可用于强制清除，当 Map 频繁读取但更新较少时非常有用。
